vulnerability: Attackers can insert malicious code or fake entries into logs; Many IP cameras use weak passwords and outdated firmware.
controls: Use MFA + mandated strong passwords for IP cameras; Manage logs in a secured and centralized SIEM system with WORM storage.

vulnerability: An employee leaves their computer open while going on a bathroom break.
controls: Raise awareness for this risk and enforce 3-minute auto-lock on computers to protect company and personal data.

vulnerability: Stress from extreme weather and increasing electricity demand.
controls: Upgrade stronger materials, bury selected critical lines in high-risk areas, and use drones and AI analysis to spot weaknesses.

vulnerability: Throwing out packages and paperwork can show what the company has inside.
controls: Ensure anything thrown out has been broken down or labels properly removed, and sensitive paper shredded.

vulnerability: Suspicious people can slip in through usually locked doors when an employee goes through them.
controls: Smart Gate mantraps with dual doors and key scanners closing immediately after valid entry, monitored by lobby security.

vulnerability: An employee's access badge could be cloned by attackers using skimming devices to read the radio frequency signal of the badge.
controls: Use multi-factor authentication with biometric scanners and unique PIN alongside badge scan; facility microsegmentation.

vulnerability: An employee may have a large monitor and an unauthorized person can record or watch their screen.
controls: Polarized privacy filters on open-area screens and strict segmentation into restricted employee-only spaces.

vulnerability: Commit keys or developer accounts targeted by nation-state actors for unauthorized source repository exfiltration outside business hours.
controls: Hardware keys (YubiKeys), HSM release signing, SIEM alert on source downloads exceeding 100 MB outside business hours.

vulnerability: Adversaries and corporate competitors targeting proprietary threat intelligence models and cryptographic patent portfolios.
controls: Zero-trust microsegmentation, AI-driven encryption, cyber liability and IP theft insurance policy.
